inputs.root_cause: Following event 153's exact_next_action (check whether the remaining xliff clusters substantially overlap with facts already resolved before assuming fresh investigation is needed), ran a programmatic exact-rule_text-match sweep across all five remaining unaudited clusters (XLIFF-MODEL-001, XLIFF-VALIDATE-001, XLIFF-TEXT-001, XLIFF-INLINE-001, XLIFF-SEC-001, 59 obligations combined) against the pool of obligations already individually resolved in the XLIFF-PARSE-001 and XLIFF-MODULE-001 ticks. Found 46 of 59 are exact-text duplicates.
inputs.obligation_targeted: 46 obligations across XLIFF-MODEL-001 (12), XLIFF-VALIDATE-001 (12), XLIFF-TEXT-001 (9), XLIFF-INLINE-001 (4), and XLIFF-SEC-001 (0 -- see note) -- see the XLIFF-CROSS-CLUSTER-CITATION-AUDIT-SELECTOR-PROOF execution_evidence entry.
inputs.acceptance_evidence: Zero new tests -- every citation is a direct carry-forward of already-verified evidence from the XLIFF-PARSE-001 and XLIFF-MODULE-001 ticks.

execution_steps: 1. Wrote a matching script that builds a canonical map of rule_text -> already-resolved-obligation from every XLIFF-PARSE-001/XLIFF-MODULE-001 obligation whose status is implemented, honest partial, or honest missing (excluding anything still carrying the original generic 'Not yet audited' placeholder, which would have produced false-positive self-matches).

2. Caught a real bug during development: an early version of the matching script counted an obligation as 'already resolved' whenever its positive_test_selectors list was merely non-empty -- which incorrectly matched obligations still carrying the ORIGINAL generic shared citation (non-empty, but never individually verified). Fixed by keying the resolved-filter on whether missing_behavior[0] still starts with the generic placeholder text, which reliably distinguishes genuinely-audited obligations from still-generic ones. Verified the fix by spot-checking specific obligation_ids directly against the file before trusting the corrected counts.

3. Applied the corrected matcher across all five remaining clusters: 46 of 59 obligations matched an already-resolved rule_text exactly. For each match, generated a new evidence block carrying forward the source obligation's exact status, source_symbols, test citations, and reasoning text, prefixed with an explicit 'Cross-capability duplicate of <source_capability>'s <source_obligation_id>' note.

4. Left the remaining 13 non-matching obligations completely untouched this slice -- 2 in XLIFF-MODEL-001 (the typed document-hierarchy object model itself), 2 in XLIFF-VALIDATE-001 (multi-scope validation, comprehensive validation matrices), 1 in XLIFF-TEXT-001 (inline-code-position-preserving editing), 3 in XLIFF-INLINE-001 (paired-code integrity guarantees), and all 5 in XLIFF-SEC-001 (security baseline behavior) -- these are genuinely distinct facts deserving dedicated fresh investigation, not force-matched or rushed.

5. Spot-checked several rendered blocks directly in the file (an implemented cross-reference, a partial cross-reference, and a missing cross-reference) to confirm the generated YAML reads correctly and traces back accurately before trusting the bulk output.

6. Ran the reconciler: first attempt failed with 'unknown execution evidence XLIFF-CROSS-CLUSTER-CITATION-AUDIT-SELECTOR-PROOF' (the new shared evidence_id referenced by all 46 blocks had not yet been added to execution_evidence) -- added the entry and re-ran: clean pass, no errors. Ran the full xliff suite to confirm zero regressions (no source or test files changed this slice) -- unchanged from baseline.
tests_run: .venv/Scripts/pytest tests/python/xliff/ -q -- unchanged from before this slice (0 source or test changes)

evidence.oracle: none -- this is format_factory's own self-consistent test evidence, not independently cross-checked against a reference XLIFF implementation. Labeled SELF-CONSISTENT per the FF6 execution-recovery directive's GAP-008 rule, not VERIFIED.
evidence.obligations_moved_breakdown: Of the 46 cross-referenced, those whose source obligation was 'implemented' status are counted as newly implemented here (promotions); those whose source was 'partial' or 'missing' carried forward that same status with precise reasoning (evidence-honesty corrections, not promotions). The 'obligations_moved' figure counts only the implemented promotions.
evidence.why_this_scaled_so_efficiently: XLIFF-PARSE-001 and XLIFF-MODULE-001's two prior ticks had already done the hard investigative work (individually classifying 54 distinct facts). This tick was pure mechanical propagation of that work to five more capability views of the same underlying facts, caught one real bug in the propagation logic before it could produce false evidence, and correctly stopped at the boundary where genuine new investigation was actually required rather than force-matching the remaining 13.
